detail.text: AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO OPERATING AGREEMENT OF Selection LLC A FLORIDA PROTECTED SERIES LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY THIS AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO OPERATING AGREEMENT (this "Amendment") of Selection LLC, a Florida protected series limited liability company (the "Company"), is made effective as of September 22, 2026, by the undersigned members (each a "Member" and collectively the "Members"), and is acknowledged by the undersigned Manager. RECITALS A. The Company is governed by the Operating Agreement of the Company effective as of January 2, 2026 (the "Agreement"). B. Section 15.1 of the Agreement provides that the Agreement may be amended only by a written instrument signed by all Members. C. The Members wish to amend the Agreement as set forth in this Amendment. NOW, THEREFORE, the Members amend the Agreement as follows: AMENDMENT 1. Amendments to the Agreement. The Agreement is amended as follows: The Agreement is amended as set forth in Exhibit A attached to this Amendment. 2. Effect of Amendment. Except as amended by this Amendment, the Agreement remains in full force and effect. Capitalized terms have the meanings given in the Agreement. This Amendment is effective on the date stated above. WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE SOLE MEMBER OF Selection LLC ESTABLISHING A NEW PROTECTED SERIES The undersigned, being the sole member of Selection LLC, a Florida protected series limited liability company (the "Company"), acting by written consent as permitted by the Company's operating agreement (the "Agreement"), adopts the following as of September 22, 2026: 1. Approval of the new Protected Series. Under s. 605.2201(1), Florida Statutes, a limited liability company may establish a protected series with the affirmative vote or consent of all of its members, and Section 3.1 of the Agreement requires that consent. The Member, being the sole member of the Company, approves the establishment of a protected series to be named: Selection LLC, PS One 2. Purpose. The purpose of the new Protected Series is any lawful purpose. 3. Ownership. The new Protected Series is established without associated members. The Company owns all of its protected-series transferable interests, and no member of the Company holds any interest in it except indirectly, through that member's interest in the Company (ss. 605.2302(1), 605.2303(2), Fla. Stat.). 4. Authority to file. The Member is authorized to sign and file the Protected Series Designation for the new Protected Series with the Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations, as provided in s. 605.2201(2), Florida Statutes, and Section 3.1 of the Agreement. The protected series is established when its Protected Series Designation takes effect (ss. 605.2201(3) and 605.0207, Florida Statutes). 5. Series Exhibit. The Series Exhibit set forth below is adopted as part of the Agreement for the new Protected Series, as Section 3.1 of the Agreement requires at or before the filing of the Protected Series Designation. 6. Records. The Company shall create and maintain, for the new Protected Series, the records required by s. 605.2301, Florida Statutes, and by Article 8 of the Agreement. 7. Effect. This consent shall be retained with the records of the Company. This Protected Series has no Associated Members (ss. 605.2302(1), 605.2303(2), Fla. Stat.). Managed by The Member, as protected-series manager (ss. 605.2304(1)-(2), 605.2107(1)(n), Fla. Stat.) Contributions to this Protected Series By the Company: None Initial Associated Assets As set forth on the Asset Schedule attached to this Series Exhibit and completed by the Member, together with the records maintained under Article 8. Describe each asset so that a stranger could identify it without asking you anything: real property — street address AND legal description, date acquired, and grantor; deposit account — institution, account title, last four digits, and date opened; vehicle — year, make, model, and VIN; equipment — description and serial number; contract — parties and date. For any asset acquired from the Company or from another Protected Series, also state the consideration paid, the payor, and the payee.
